item.title: Telkom Completes USD 4.8 Billion InfraNexia Network Asset Spinoff
item.summary: Telkom Indonesia announced that it has completed the second phase of its two-phase spinoff of network infrastructure assets to its operational subsidiary, InfraNexia, with a total transaction value of IDR 85.7 trillion (approximately USD 4.8 billion). The company first revealed its plans for the spinoff in September 2025, and shareholders approved the initiative in December.
